prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Summon Your Pet to the Desktop", "Your pet is ready! Click the button below to bring them directly onto your screen and see where they live on your taskbar.", "Click to summon me!", "Spawn Pet on Desktop"]
1: ["Sign into your existing account to restore previous pets. Creating a new account will not share pet data.", "Account Sync Protection", "Make sure to use the email connected to your previous pet to avoid resetting your progress."]
2: ["What Kind of Companion Do You Want?", "Answer two quick questions to find your ideal desktop companion path.", "Continue"]
3: ["Try Desktop Controls", "Practice Controlling Your Pet", "Try moving, minimizing, or speaking with your pet right here before sending them to your desktop.", "Finish Setup & Launch Pet"]
4: ["Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Home", "If generation takes longer than expected, your pet file is still safely saving in the background."]
5: ["Verify & Customize Your Pet's Photo", "Upload a clear photo to ensure accurate pet generation."]
6: ["Preset path takes ~30 seconds. Custom photo creation takes ~2 minutes."]
7: ["Quick Sign In", "Connect your account in one click to safeguard your pet."]
8: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Give your new desktop companion an official name to complete their registration.", "Register & Adopt Pet"]
9: ["Onboarding Complete - Meet Your Companion!", "Day 1 Explorer Badge Unlocked", "Your pet is now active on your desktop screen!"]
